tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Retrieve trading signals and market indices (Breakouts, Liquidations, ETF flows, Token Unlocks, Market Sentiment) from specific Discord channels

channelName.description:
Authorized channel name. Use one of the following:
- 'breakout-htf': Detects 1D and 3D timeframes. Alerts on price breaking the high/low of the current candle relative to the previous 100 candles. Once per candle.
- 'breakout-mtf': Detects 1H and 4H timeframes. Alerts on price breaking the high/low of the current candle relative to the previous 100 candles. Once per candle.
- 'breakout-24h': Continuous rolling detection based on the past 24-hour high/low. First alert is a day breakout, followed by continuous alerts if price trends further.
- 'liquidation': Large liquidation order alerts.
- 'token-unlock': Token unlock event highlights with countdowns.
- 'exhaustion-seller/buyer': Grim Reaper indicator based. Alerts when 30m liquidation inventory is highly concentrated (<10%), often signaling imminent reversal.
- 'golden-pit-ltf/mtf': Power Ranger 'Smart Cloud' patterns, typically followed by significant programmatic moves (Pump/Dump) after signaled . mtf channel detects 30m/1h/4h timeframes, ltf detects 5m/15m timeframes
- 'etf-tracker': Daily inflows/outflows for BTC/ETH (UTC 5:01) and SOL/XRP (UTC 5:11).
- 'market-today': Daily Alt Season Index and Fear And Greed Index (UTC 0:24-0:30).
